comment: M13 #405 regression budgets. Ceilings are reviewed ceilings, not targets — changes are a reviewable diff. Lane values are wall-clock seconds measured by scripts/run-bun-test-group.mjs on the CI runner. The build lane is declared here so its ceiling is MEASURABLE by scripts/check-budgets.mjs; its CI enforcement point is the code-foundry runtime, which owns that lane.

e2e.comment: The E2E lane runs as two shards (e2e_shards in .github/code-foundry.yml), so the value the runner measures is one shard, not the whole lane. The ceiling is the unchanged reviewed lane ceiling: the lane's wall clock is the slower shard and stays inside it. The baseline is the measured per-shard projection: the per-file costs measured in runs 39346283807 and 39263107268 sum to 52.3s per shard, and the whole lane measured 82.7s on main and 74.8-80.7s locally.

build.comment: The CI Build lane's wall clock. The lane itself is defined by the code-foundry runtime, so this repository can MEASURE the ceiling (scripts/check-budgets.mjs lane --group build --seconds <n>) but its CI enforcement point is that external runtime. The baseline is the 254 s measured in Validation run 35462414764 (#405 M13 audit).

dist.comment: Sum of packages/*/dist + apps/*/dist, checked by scripts/check-budgets.mjs dist after a full build.

dependencies.comment: Unique external package@version pairs from `bun pm ls --all`; #405 counted 274 at c37de22 with 6 known duplicated-major transitive pairs.

startup.comment: Cold start to /ready for apps/local-control-plane on a developer host; measured by the documented probe, not wired into CI.

rss.comment: Main-process peak RSS at idle after ready; measured by the documented probe, not wired into CI. Re-evaluate sizing whenever marketplace artifact budgets change (#194 rule).
